description: This source file defines a utility class 'LocaleUtils' that provides static methods for handling locale-related operations such as obtaining a Locale object from language or merchant store information, and retrieving the request language from an HTTP session.

classes.name: LocaleUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to work with Java Locale objects and integrate with application-specific language and store models.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object from a Language object, using its code.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object based on the currency code of a MerchantStore, matching it against available locales.

methods.name: getRequestLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object from an HttpServletRequest's session or falls back to the store default language.
